title: Angela's 3 Level Cave
description:
That’s quite a drop! X marks the spot, but you never know if that unstable patch of dirt you’re digging into is going to collapse and send you tumbling down into an underground creek. Or perhaps you’ve finally found the secret entrance to the smuggler’s cove, and have to carefully wind your way down the treacherous rope bridges and ladders, careful not to make one fateful slip? Fully animated and phased over three layers from top to bottom, this cavernous map might have your players wishing they weren’t free…free falling!

I've been wanting to do a map you 'climb down' for awhile now. I hope you find a fun way to use it. I am looking forward to midsummer this weekend but I hope the rain stays away! Not much else is happening here. Have a great week guys and thanks for your support!
